common.tagline: Your companion for barangay health work.

home.heading: Welcome to BHW Connect
home.body: This is the foundation shell for Phase 1. Features roll out one increment at a time.

privacy.heading: Privacy Notice
privacy.body: The full Data Privacy Act notice ships with the consent flow in a later increment.

login.heading: Log in to BHW Connect
login.subheading: Use the username and password your admin gave you.
login.timedOut: You were signed out after 8 hours of inactivity. Please log in again.

errors.deactivated: This account has been deactivated. Contact your barangay admin.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Try again after {until}.

changePassword.heading: Set a new password
changePassword.subheading: This is a temporary password from your admin. Choose a new one to continue.
changePassword.hint: At least 8 characters. No need for symbols or numbers.

errors.missing: Enter and confirm your new password.
errors.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.weak: That password couldn't be used. Try a different one.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

consent.heading: Privacy Notice & Consent
consent.intro: Before you continue, please read how BHW Connect handles your information under the Data Privacy Act of 2012.
consent.collectBody: Your name, contact number, address, barangay assignment, login activity, and the questions you ask the Chat Guide.
consent.whyBody: To run your account, show you the right content for your area, and help your barangay improve its health information materials.
consent.retentionBody: Chat messages and usage data are kept for up to 24 months. Records of account and admin actions are kept for 5 years, as required for audit purposes.
consent.rightsBody: You may ask your barangay admin for a copy of your data, or to have your account deactivated and your personal details removed, at any time.
